calls.statement:
WITH l AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(etl_loaded_at) mn_etl, max(etl_loaded_at) mx_etl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) n_etl, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposnet FROM l

SELECT 'fact' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) units FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-27' AND DATE '2026-08-04' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT sum(f.quantity) u, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'),
b AS (SELECT sum(units_sold) u, sum(receipts) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT a.u fact_units, b.u rpt_units, a.r fact_receipts, b.r rpt_receipts FROM a, b

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = f.sale_date THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) mismatched, count(*) n, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN quantity END) units_by_ts FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-27' AND DATE '2026-08-04'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units_ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.subcategory
